items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: You know those B-Guy's playing? Well that's, that's real old, old time.

ctx.x: Yeah, but what do you think is, what is it that isn't as good now? What is it that's changed about the music?

Well you see, I'm gonna tell you what's changed about it, for one thing. You see, like, this man takes solo, that other man take a solo, that time there's no, everybody take no solo. You understand? Yeah. Alright, you take the rhythm section, there was a real background, a foundation, see. Alright, if the trumpet take a solo, trombone, and the clarinet would make a, a whiff, what you call, a riff in between, you know, behind him, to send him. And, uh, a clarinet player would take it, the trombone and the trumpet…
Also they didn't seem to have, like in the old days they had, not far into something, they had the banjo more. Yeah, yeah.
